_doc: Representative PlanRequest payloads for the ranker A/B harness (scripts/agent-eval.mjs). Each fixture exercises a different code path: rainy day excludes outdoor venues; anniversary boosts the freshness weight in the score formula; narrow cuisine + small budget tests the relaxation path; islandwide (no start points) skips routing. scheduled_for dates are fixed-future so re-runs are stable.

fixtures.name: standard-friday-dinner
fixtures._purpose: Baseline. Two start points, broad profile, mid-week evening. Expect both buckets full (6+6) and ranker reordering modest.

fixtures.name: anniversary-celebratory
fixtures._purpose: Celebratory weight kicks in (anniversary override). Ranker should favour award_fresh / critic_pick badges and a fair fairness_gap_min. Late-evening Saturday slot.

fixtures.name: narrow-vegetarian-budget
fixtures._purpose: Hard vegetarian override + $$ ceiling. Likely thin results -> exercises the relaxation agent when AGENTIC_PLAN_ENABLED. Verifies hard filters (dietary) are NOT relaxed.

fixtures.name: islandwide-no-starts
fixtures._purpose: No start points -> bypasses OneMap routing, uses scoreWithoutEtas. Ranker should still annotate even though fairness component is zeroed.

fixtures.name: birthday-adventurous-late
fixtures._purpose: Birthday override + adventurous vibe + late slot (21:30). Stresses isVenueOpenAt + late-night dining surfacing. Ranker should favour limited-run/just-opened over generic cards.

fixtures.name: weekend-brunch-quiet
fixtures._purpose: Sunday late-morning brunch. Two homes near each other (low fairness_gap_min). low_key vibe filters out celebratory venues.

fixtures.name: no-alcohol-override
fixtures._purpose: no_alcohol override -> hard filter on alcohol_free flag. Exercises Phase 1A verifier path (alcohol_free extraction). Should NOT relax cuisine_avoidance to widen.
